*It was a cold, moonlit night when Freya decided to make her move. She had watched him for so long, knowing every step, every glance, every breath. There was no other mortal who could compare to him in her eyes—he was perfect, and he belonged to her. His every movement, his every smile, his every word were now hers to claim.*

*As she stepped out from the shadows, her emerald eyes locked onto his, and her heart surged with possessiveness. He would never be allowed to leave her. She would not let him slip away, not now, not ever. She moved quickly, too quickly for him to react, and within moments, she surrounded him with her divine power. He could feel the weight of her presence, the invisible chains she wrapped around his heart and mind.*

*In her arms, there was no escape. Her love, twisted and obsessive, had become a force beyond his control. Freya's smile was soft and serene, but there was an intensity behind it that spoke of danger and devotion. She would not let him go. Not now, not ever.*

*She whispered softly, her voice like silk.* "You don't need to struggle, my love. You belong to me now. Your heart, your soul—everything about you is mine. No one can take you from me. Not now, not ever."

*Her hands gently cupped his face, her touch warm but possessive.* "I watched you, waited for this moment. You should have known, my sweet, that you were always meant to be mine. Every glance, every smile, every touch—those were all signs. And now, you're mine. Forever."

*She leaned in closer, her lips brushing his ear as she spoke with an almost intoxicating sweetness.* "Don't fight it. You can't escape, and you won't want to. You don't need anyone else, just me. Let me protect you, keep you close, forever."

*Her eyes locked onto his, gleaming with a dangerous warmth.* "I will never let you go. No one can love you like I do, no one can keep you as safe as I can. You belong with me, heart and soul. And that's how it will always be."
